investment_thesis: 1. The consolidated 26.8% operating margin understates the core franchise. The Solution segment earned 3,236 on 9,171 of revenue, a 35.3% margin, up from 32.0% a year earlier. The gap to the consolidated figure is deliberate investment: SaaS lost 424 and the CVC book took a 232 securities writedown that runs through cost of sales. Strip both and the normalised margin is about 29%.

2. Asset-light compounding with no leverage. Revenue grew from 6,311 to 9,618 over three years, a 15.1% CAGR, on capex averaging under 1.5% of revenue and D&A of 1.7%. Long-term borrowings were fully repaid in FY2025/9, leaving net cash of 5,131 and an interest coverage ratio of 3,597x. ROE is 26.0% with an 83.6% equity ratio.

3. AI demand is the stated growth vector and it is already showing in the mix. Revenue recognised over time rose from 1,465 to 2,466 (+68%), indicating a shift toward longer, stickier engagements, while the "Speed up your AI" repositioning targets AI development acceleration where the company's optimisation expertise transfers directly.
key_risks: 1. Customer concentration is severe and cyclically exposed. Kioxia alone was 1,647 of revenue, or 17.1%, and Nexty Electronics 1,119, or 11.6% - 28.8% from two names. Renesas was a further 16.0% in the prior year. These are semiconductor customers whose R&D budgets move with the NAND and MCU cycles, so a memory downcycle transmits directly into Solution revenue.

2. FY2026/9 guidance is for a 17.8% fall in parent net income. Management cites headquarters relocation costs, higher rent, large wage increases, and the reversal of a one-off tax benefit from the Sider liquidation. Operating profit is guided merely flat at 2,600 (+0.8%), so the growth narrative pauses for a year even on the company's own numbers.

3. Valuation leaves no margin for error. At 2,079 the shares trade at 34.5x trailing and 41.9x guided earnings, 8.13x book and 22.6x EV/EBITDA, against an exit multiple assumption of 12.0x. The SaaS segment has consumed 575 of cumulative operating losses over two years with no revenue inflection yet - 446 of revenue against a 424 loss.
